name: js-obfuscator-pro
description: Obfuscate JavaScript, TypeScript and inline HTML scripts from inside VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Renamed identifiers, all strings base64-encoded. Fast, small output.
Adds self-defending code and disables console output.
Adds control-flow flattening, dead code and split strings. Slower, larger output.
Adds rc4 string encoding and debug protection. Much slower and larger. Browser code only: debug protection keeps a timer running, so Node.js processes never exit.
jsObfuscator.preset.markdownDescription: Base obfuscation preset. The `#jsObfuscator.options.*#` settings you change, then `.obfuscatorrc.json`, are applied on top of it.

jsObfuscator.output.suffix.markdownDescription: Added before the extension by **Obfuscate File to New File**: `app.js` becomes `app.obfuscated.js`.

jsObfuscator.output.folder.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the workspace folder, that **Obfuscate All JavaScript in Folder** mirrors its output into.

jsObfuscator.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns skipped by **Obfuscate All JavaScript in Folder**, such as `**/*.html` to leave HTML pages out. With more than one entry, patterns cannot contain `{}` themselves; add separate entries instead.

jsObfuscator.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the preset that applies to the active JavaScript, TypeScript or HTML file in the status bar.

jsObfuscator.options.target.markdownDescription:
Where the code runs: browser, browser-no-eval (no eval-based helpers), node, or service-worker.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.compact.markdownDescription:
Write the output on a single line.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.identifierNamesGene.markdownDescription:
Style of new names: hexadecimal (_0xab12cd), mangled (a, b, c), mangled-shuffled, or dictionary (from identifiersDictionary).

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.renameGlobals.markdownDescription:
Also rename global variables and functions. Breaks code in other files (or around a selection) that uses them by name.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.reservedNames.markdownDescription:
Regular expressions; identifiers matching any of them are never renamed.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.reservedStrings.markdownDescription:
Regular expressions; strings matching any of them are never transformed.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.stringArray.markdownDescription:
Move string literals into a shared array and replace them with lookups.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.stringArrayEncoding.markdownDescription:
How strings in the string array are encoded: none, base64, or rc4 (slower). With several values, each string gets one at random.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.stringArrayThreshol.markdownDescription:
Fraction (0 to 1) of string literals moved into the string array.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.splitStrings.markdownDescription:
Split string literals into chunks of splitStringsChunkLength characters.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.controlFlowFlatteni.markdownDescription:
Restructure the code flow so it is harder to follow. Noticeably slows the code down.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

Fraction (0 to 1) of code affected by control-flow flattening.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.deadCodeInjection.markdownDescription:
Insert blocks of code that never run. Greatly increases output size.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.deadCodeInjectionTh.markdownDescription:
Fraction (0 to 1) of code affected by dead-code injection.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.numbersToExpression.markdownDescription:
Replace number literals with equivalent arithmetic expressions.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.transformObjectKeys.markdownDescription:
Obfuscate the keys of object literals.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.unicodeEscapeSequen.markdownDescription:
Write strings as unicode escape sequences. Greatly increases output size.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.selfDefending.markdownDescription:
Make the code stop working if it is reformatted or beautified. Do not modify the output afterwards.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.disableConsoleOutpu.markdownDescription:
Replace console.log, console.warn and the other console methods with empty functions.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.debugProtection.markdownDescription:
Make browser developer tools hard to use on the code.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.sourceMap.markdownDescription:
Generate a source map pointing back at the original file (the .ts file for TypeScript). Not for HTML pages or selections. Keep maps private: they undo the obfuscation.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

jsObfuscator.options.sourceMapMode.markdownDescription:
separate writes <output>.map next to the output file; inline embeds the map in the output.

Only overrides the preset when you set it.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --minify
scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
